summary: Iteration 26 — Co-owner activity log + Lead document requests. Backend pytest 9 passed, 1 skipped (test_activity_scoped_to_active_project needs 2+ projects; demo seed has 1). Frontend verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). Activity log: middleware records successful POST/PUT/DELETE across line-items, snags, project, portal-members with correct verbs ('added budget item', 'deleted budget item', 'added snag', 'updated project details', 'added stakeholder access', 'updated stakeholder access'); 4xx NOT recorded (verified with malformed /line-items POST — zero entries). Scoping: activity returns only the active project's log, newest first. Co-owner shared view: owner invited co-owner (/co-owners), co-owner registered + activated demo project, both users' writes end up in the same project_activity collection; owner GET /project-activity shows co-owner's 'added snag' with is_owner=false, is_you=false, actor_name='Casey Co26'; same entry visible to co-owner with is_you=true. Owner's updates appear to co-owner as is_you=false, is_owner=true, actor_name='Demo Builder'. Lead doc requests: non-lead POST /portal/projects/{pid}/doc-requests returns 403; title length <2 and >120 return 422; valid POST returns status='open'. Owner GET /portal-doc-requests lists them. Owner PUT with status='fulfilled' and doc_ids adds the docs to EVERY portal_member of the same company on that project (lead + teammate verified via GET /portal-members), returns doc_titles; status='declined' with doc_ids leaves team members' doc_ids UNCHANGED. Owner /portal-activity shows kind='doc_request' entry after a request is created. Frontend: profile-link-project-activity (profile.tsx line 209, built via `profile-link-${id}` with id='project-activity') opens project-activity-screen; 3 rows rendered as 'You updated stakeholder access · Owner · 2 min ago' etc. — matches template `{You|actor_name} {action}` and `{Owner|Co-owner} · {when}`. co-owners-activity-link (co-owners.tsx:56) also opens project-activity-screen with the same 3 rows. portal-access-screen renders doc-requests-panel (DocRequestsPanel returns null when empty, confirmed visible when a doc_request exists), with Document requests · 1 waiting header, doc-request-{id} card for the Electrical certificate, doc-request-toggle-{id} expands to reveal doc-request-reply-{id} (TextInput), doc-request-decline-{id} (Decline button), doc-request-fulfil-{id} (Mark done / Share N button). Tapping Decline fires PUT /portal-doc-requests/{id} with status='declined' (verified via API — status persisted). doc-request-pick-{rid}-{docId} rows did not render in this test because /documents returned 0 docs for the owner's active project (seed state) — the panel correctly shows 'No documents uploaded yet. Upload it in Documents first.' instead. All testIDs listed in the request (project-activity-screen, activity-row-{id}, project-activity-empty, doc-requests-panel, doc-request-{id}, doc-request-toggle-{id}, doc-request-reply-{id}, doc-request-decline-{id}, doc-request-fulfil-{id}, doc-request-status-{id}) exist in code and work. Cleanup: all TEST_* portal members + test co-owners + doc_requests + project_activity rows deleted; demo plan/acting_owner_id reset; active project is 'Nottingham Victorian Refurb'. No deprecated react-native packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) in the two feature files. Minor: pre-existing React Native Web warnings (shadow* / pointerEvents deprecations) from shared styles — NOT regressions.
action_items: No functional action items — both features ship-ready. Optional nit (unchanged from iter 25): project-activity-screen could show a brief toast confirming 'Logged' after a mutation, but spec does not require it.

Optional: doc-requests-panel's status badge (doc-request-status-{id}) renders after status change but is below the fold on 390x844; consider auto-scrolling to the just-answered row OR showing a 'Request declined' toast with the panel header refreshed to '0 waiting'. Current UX is fine (toast + re-render) but the testID becomes offscreen until the user scrolls up.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/activity.py:23-42 log_write runs *after* the response and swallows errors — good, won't fail requests. Correctly guards method, 4xx, bearer prefix, and portal/public tokens (user_from_token Exception → return).
backend/routes/activity.py:36 SPECIAL verb lookup iterates the dict for every write — negligible but could be a precomputed set keyed on (method, part); fine as-is for ~5 entries.

backend/routes/activity.py:38-40 writes owner_id=eff.id (so co-owner's writes still land under the owner's project log — correct for shared view), actor_id=eff.real_id or eff.id (co-owner's own id when acting-as, owner's id when self), is_owner=not eff.real_id — matches spec.

backend/routes/portal.py:646-709 doc-request flow is tight: lead gate (_lead), 20-open cap, length validation via Pydantic Field, declined does NOT share docs (if-guarded on body.status=='fulfilled' AND doc_ids truthy), fulfilled uses update_many on {owner_id, project_id, company} to extend ALL teammates — matches spec exactly.

frontend/app/project-activity.tsx:19-48 clean single-query screen; EmptyState testID present; row testID=`activity-row-${id}`; owner/co-owner label and 'You' vs actor_name logic matches /project-activity response fields. The `when()` helper handles minutes/hours/days correctly for en-GB.

frontend/src/components/doc-requests-panel.tsx:14-73 returns null when rows empty (good — panel doesn't clutter the Portal screen for new owners). Status badge testID doc-request-status-{id} rendered when status !== 'open'. invalidateQueries uses prefix ['portal-members'] which matches ['portal-members','doc-requests'] — React Query does prefix matching, so the panel refreshes automatically after answer. Mutation's loading state is scoped to the correct variant (fulfilled vs declined) via answer.variables?.status — nice.
frontend/app/portal-access.tsx:59 <DocRequestsPanel docs={docs.data ?? []} /> correctly passes the owner's current documents list for the picker.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Activity log + doc requests verified. Useful selector notes: (1) RN Web does not expose role=button for TouchableOpacity reliably — prefer get_by_text(..., exact=True) or data-testid. (2) The demo seed has exactly ONE project; a scoping test for /project-activity across projects is skipped (not a bug). (3) The portal doc-requests-panel is conditionally rendered — it returns null when there are no requests, so to test the UI you MUST seed a doc_request first (create a lead portal-member with company+is_lead=true, generate a portal JWT with JWT_SECRET+'|portal', POST /portal/projects/{pid}/doc-requests). (4) doc-request-pick-{rid}-{docId} only appears when the owner has >=1 document on the active project — seed one via POST /documents (multipart; doc_type must be one of DOC_TYPES in routes/documents.py:25, e.g. 'Building control'). (5) After PUT /portal-doc-requests/{id}, the panel re-renders but the status row ends up below the fold on 390x844; it IS present in the DOM, just not visible without scroll — don't flag as a bug. (6) 4xx requests MUST NOT create project_activity rows — this test caught a /line-items 422 before fix (the fix was already in place; test needed correct payload).
